A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/Veo Technologies

Club pays for a coaching tool

Veo TechnologiesPremium

Copenhagen, Denmark · founded 2015 · active · www.veo.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolPortable unitItalian partnerEvidence A€500 to €2,000 to start

Veo sells a tripod-mounted twin-lens camera (Veo Cam 3) and a two-iPhone variant (Veo Go) that record the whole pitch unattended, then stitch, follow the ball and cut highlights in the cloud for a subscription fee veo-06, veo-22.

For Amateur and youth football clubs, schools and academies that want match and training video without a camera operator, with the club or team owning the camera and paying a yearly plan per camera veo-04, veo-02. Veo Go extends the same platform to teams that already own two recent iPhones and want to spend under 300 euros a year veo-02, veo-22.

Veo exists because grassroots clubs wanted the analysis habit of professional football without the staff, and a 1,299 euro camera plus a 579 to 1,159 euro yearly plan made that habit affordable veo-02. It matters now because the company has crossed 500 million Danish kroner in revenue and cut its annual loss to under 5 million kroner in 2025, which puts it closer to breakeven than any other portable camera vendor whose accounts I have read veo-08. The Lega Nazionale Dilettanti partnership of September 2025 and the free Analytics 2 bundle running to 30 September 2026 show where the space is going, with hardware treated as a loss leader and the money made on data and analytics add-ons veo-11, veo-05.

Price band €1,299 camera (€1,599 for the 5G model) plus €579 to €1,979 per year for Editor plans, with Analytics 2, Live and Player Spotlight add-ons priced separately; Veo Go from €279 per year with the phone rig and tripod included on yearly terms veo-02

Italy Veo is an official partner of the Lega Nazionale Dilettanti since 8 September 2025, sells in Italian through veo.com/it with Cittadella, Südtirol, Como and AC Crema shown as customers, and is resold by the analysis software house Sics as an official partner veo-11, veo-13, veo-26.

The verdict

Look if You run a club with one to ten teams, you want match video available in the app the same evening with automatic highlights, and you are willing to own the camera and pay per camera per year veo-04, veo-02. Italian LND-affiliated clubs should look now, because the current bundle gives away the camera or the Analytics 2 add-on on a 12-month Team plan, which turns the first year into a 929 euro decision veo-05, veo-12.

Skip if You need live streaming as the core product, because Veo Live is an add-on that pushes RTMP to YouTube or Facebook and the fan app shows freezing complaints in reviews veo-04, veo-20. You need to export the panoramic master or tracking data for your own analysis pipeline, because downloads are limited to the follow-cam MP4 and Analytics data cannot be exported veo-23.

Watch-outs

  • Only the follow-cam view can be downloaded, the panoramic and interactive views and all Analytics data stay inside the platform, so ownership of your footage is narrower than it looks veo-23.
  • The Starter plan runs six months of storage and excludes downloads, so a club that stops paying loses access to its archive veo-04, veo-23.
  • The free-repair window is one year from delivery, after which battery repairs cost 200 euros and other components 350 euros, and a triggered G-force meter voids the claim veo-18.
  • Trustpilot shows 34 percent one-star reviews out of 1,282, with recurring complaints about auto-renewal charges after cancellation and slow support escalation veo-21.
  • Veo acts as processor only, so the club is the data controller and carries the consent burden for filming minors, and Veo documents no blurring or opt-out tooling for people on the pitch veo-14, veo-17.
  • The Italian promotion price for the Cam 3 plus Analytics 2 bundle is rendered as a placeholder on the page, so confirm the invoice total against the catalogue prices before signing veo-05, veo-02.

Products

  • Veo Cam 3 (camera). Twin-lens 1080p follow-cam camera with 180 degree panorama, 6.5 hour battery, 96 GB storage, Wi-Fi and Ethernet, sold outright at 1,299 EUR veo-06, veo-07, veo-02.
  • Veo Cam 3 (5G) (camera). Same camera with a nano SIM slot for cellular upload and live streaming, 1,599 EUR veo-06, veo-02.
  • Veo Go (app). Two iPhone 11 or newer handsets in a rig record and upload, Veo stitches them into a panoramic follow-cam; 20 hours per month, 15 users, six months storage, no analytics add-ons, from 279 EUR per year veo-22, veo-02.
  • Veo Editor (platform). Web and iOS platform with automatic event clips, drawing tools, speedrun, journals and follow-cam MP4 download, sold as Starter, Team, Club, Club+, Enterprise and School plans veo-24, veo-04.
  • Veo Analytics 2 (add-on). Football-only player tracking with distance, speed, sprints, duels and passing stats linked to jersey numbers veo-17.
  • Veo Live (add-on). Live streaming to the Veo Live app and RTMP destinations such as YouTube and Facebook veo-04.
  • Veo Player Spotlight (add-on). Individual player highlight reels veo-02.
  • Veo League Exchange (platform). Shared video exchange for leagues, used in the US Youth Soccer deal veo-25, veo-16.

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
Veo is built for the club that films its own matches and training with no operator and reviews them in the Veo Editor, with plans sized from one team and 15 users on Starter to 20 teams and 600 users on Enterprise veo-04, veo-02. Football is the primary sport with automatic event detection for goals, shots, corners and free kicks, and Analytics 2 is football only veo-24, veo-04. Schools and multi-sport programs are served with US-only School plans at 2,499 and 2,999 dollars per year veo-01.
Capture quality
Veo Cam 3 records two synchronised streams stitched to a 180 degree panorama and outputs a 1080p follow-cam, with an interactive mode that lets the viewer pan and zoom the full pitch veo-06. The camera weighs 1.25 kilograms, carries 96.81 gigabytes of internal storage and runs up to 6.5 hours recording or 4.5 hours recording plus live streaming on one charge, within a stated operating range of minus 10 to 45 degrees Celsius veo-07. Veo Go relies on the ultra-wide sensors of two iPhone 11 or newer handsets and needs roughly 6 gigabytes of phone storage per hour per phone veo-22.
Automation accuracy
The follow-cam and event detection run in Veo's cloud AI pipeline after upload, which is described in the data processing agreement as stitching, follow-cam, interactive mode and game event detection veo-17. Veo publishes no accuracy figures, and App Store reviewers report analytics data that misses moments when checked against possession statistics and a zoom that stays wider than coaches want veo-19. Trustpilot reviews from 2026 describe the automatic tracking as working well for the typical amateur match veo-21.
Multi-angle and stitching
The system is a single two-lens unit that stitches one panorama, so there is no multi-camera production and no second angle behind the goal in the product line veo-06. Veo Go combines two separate iPhones into one panoramic field view with follow-cam, which is the closest Veo comes to multi-device capture veo-22.
Latency and live readiness
Live streaming requires the Veo Live add-on, priced from 119 euros per year on Starter to 469 euros per year on Enterprise in Italy, and pushes to YouTube, Facebook or any RTMP endpoint veo-02, veo-04. The 5G camera variant at 1,599 euros takes a nano SIM for streaming without Wi-Fi veo-02, veo-06. Veo publishes no latency figures, and the fan-facing Veo Live app has 13,000 ratings at 4.8 stars with a visible minority reporting streams that freeze after a minute or two veo-20.
Reliability and resilience
The Veo Cam app holds 4.7 stars from 1,500 ratings with reviewers reporting whole seasons without failures, alongside individual reports of overheating and of an APN settings button that does not respond veo-19. Trustpilot carries battery drain complaints and a refurbished replacement path exists at 579 euros for a Cam 3 and 749 euros for the 5G model when repair fails after year one veo-21, veo-18, veo-02. Recording is local to the camera with upload once connected, so a dropped connection during the match does not lose the file veo-06.
Portability and install
The camera mounts on a 5.2 metre tripod at 249 euros or a 7.4 metre tripod at 399 euros, with a 149 euro stadium mount package for permanent positions and a 89 euro travel case veo-02. Setup is a tripod-and-record workflow with no cabling, and an Ethernet dongle is sold separately for fixed installs veo-07. Veo Go needs only the 39 euro tripod and the 20 euro phone rig, both included free on yearly Go plans veo-02, veo-22.
Connectivity and bandwidth
Veo Cam 3 uploads over Wi-Fi or a phone hotspot, the 5G variant adds a cellular modem, and Ethernet works through an adaptor veo-07. Veo publishes no minimum upload bandwidth, and processing time is described only as dependent on connection and match length veo-06. Recording hours per month are capped by plan at 10 hours on Starter, 20 on Team and 200 on Club, which sets the practical upload budget veo-04.
Workflow and UX
The Veo Editor offers automatic clips for shots and goals, manual clips and bookmarks, drawing tools, a speedrun mode that skips dead time, player of the match, timelines and journals, in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Polish veo-24. Reviewers praise setup and ease of use and criticise player selection that cannot group users and the removal of an in-app feedback tool in version 3.2.10 veo-21, veo-19. The platform runs in the browser at app.veo.co plus iOS apps for camera control and viewing veo-23, veo-24.
Analysis layer
Analytics 2 is a football-only add-on that tracks distance, speed, sprints, tackles, duels, dribbles, interceptions, passes and conversion rate per player and links jersey numbers to invited users veo-17. In Italy it costs 679 euros per year on Starter and Team, 799 on Club and 1,699 on Enterprise, while the older Analytics tier costs 259 to 799 euros per year veo-02. Player Spotlight, priced from 329 euros per year, produces individual highlight reels veo-02.
Integrations
The Veo Editor page names no third-party analysis integrations, and export is limited to MP4 follow-cam files and clips veo-24, veo-23. In Italy the analysis vendor Sics states that Veo footage is compatible with its VideoMatch software and presents itself as an official partner veo-26. Veo League Exchange gives leagues a shared video library, and the sub-processor list notes that exchange participants without a Veo subscription have their data stored in AWS us-east-1 veo-25, veo-16.
Distribution and OTT
Distribution is limited to the Veo Live app for fans, RTMP output to YouTube, Facebook or another platform via the Live add-on, and shared links or clips veo-04, veo-20. There is no white-label OTT product, no pay-per-view and no advertising layer in the catalogue veo-01, veo-02. Federation deals such as US Youth Soccer and the LND are structured as member discounts and carry no distribution rights veo-25, veo-11.
Data access and ownership
Customers can download the follow-cam view as MP4 on all plans above Starter, but the panoramic and interactive views, drawings and Analytics data cannot be downloaded veo-23. Storage is six months on Starter and Veo Go and twelve months on Team, Club and Enterprise, so long-term archives depend on the club exporting files itself veo-04. The data processing agreement obliges Veo to delete or return personal data at the controller's choice on termination veo-17.
Privacy and compliance
Veo positions itself as data processor and the club as controller, refers data-subject enquiries back to the club and publishes a GDPR Article 28 data processing agreement dated 18 August 2026 veo-14, veo-17. Recordings are stored in AWS eu-west-1 in Dublin, with EU-US transfers under the Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses for other transfers veo-16. No face blurring, no opt-out for individuals on the pitch and no specific guidance on minors appear in the public documents veo-14, veo-17.
Security
Veo states that its data centres are ISO 27001 certified, that all traffic is encrypted over HTTPS and that it runs annual penetration tests, but it publishes no certification of its own veo-15. Infrastructure activity is logged through the cloud provider's native audit logging and the DPA grants the controller audit rights at its own expense veo-17. There is no public SOC 2 report or status page in the documents reviewed veo-15.
Pricing and TCO
In Italy a football club pays 1,299 euros for the camera, 249 euros for the 5.2 metre tripod and 929 euros per year on the Team plan, which gives a first-year cost of roughly 2,477 euros before VAT and before add-ons veo-02. Multi-year terms cut the annual figure, with Team at 1,599 euros for 24 months and 2,099 euros for 36 months veo-02. Veo Go at 279 euros per year with free rig and tripod is the lowest entry price in this database for full-pitch stitched video, while the US market pays 999 dollars for Starter and 1,399 dollars for Team on the same plans veo-02, veo-01.
Support and service
Support runs through the help centre and a ticket system that requires an account, with priority support and a dedicated account manager reserved for Enterprise veo-04, veo-20. The repair policy gives one year of free repair or replacement for manufacturing defects and paid repair in years two and three, with no published turnaround time veo-18. Reviews split between customers praising fast responses and customers who escalated to the CEO to get a battery replaced veo-21.
Company health and roadmap
Veo Technologies ApS reported revenue of 503.9 million Danish kroner in 2025, up from 446.1 million in 2024, with the annual loss narrowing from 58.1 million to 4.6 million kroner and equity of 177.9 million kroner veo-08. The company raised 80 million dollars in Series C in June 2022 led by pension fund ATP, employs around 320 people and counts Chr. Augustinus Fabrikker as a more than 10 percent shareholder veo-09, veo-10. Recent product direction is visible in the catalogue, with Analytics 2, Veo Go and School plans added and Cam 3 hardware unchanged since 2024 veo-01, veo-02.
Evidence and references
Italian customers shown on veo.com/it include Cittadella, Südtirol, AC Crema, Como and Ciliverghe Calcio, with a Primavera match analyst quoted veo-13. Federation partnerships include the Lega Nazionale Dilettanti, US Youth Soccer on a five-year term with a 200 dollar camera discount, and several English county FAs veo-11, veo-25, veo-13. The LND announcement carries Veo's own scale claims of 4.5 million matches recorded, 2.5 million registered users and activity in more than 100 countries veo-11. Italian trade press in August 2026 lists the Cam 3 among the reference cameras for football with the subscription dependency as its main drawback veo-27.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
The Veo Cam app scores 4.7 from 1,500 ratings and the Veo Live app 4.8 from 13,000, while Trustpilot sits at 4.0 with 49 percent five-star and 34 percent one-star reviews veo-19, veo-20, veo-21. Coaches praise the reliability of the tracking and the ease of use, and complain about analytics gaps, the wide default framing and the cost of add-ons described as being nickel and dimed veo-19, veo-21. Support tickets left open for months appear in both app store and Trustpilot reviews veo-19, veo-21.
Edge versus cloud
Veo Cam 3 records locally and all AI processing, stitching, follow-cam and event detection happen in Veo's AWS cloud after upload, so nothing is available until the file has been transferred and processed veo-17, veo-06. Live streaming is the exception, with the camera pushing a stream directly while recording veo-07. Veo Go processes nothing on the phone beyond capture and depends entirely on the upload of two files veo-22.
Accessibility and languages
The Editor and website are available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Polish veo-24. Veo runs an Italian marketing team with a named Italy marketing manager quoted by the LND veo-11. Veo Go excludes iPhone SE and iPhone 16e, so the phone route depends on the handsets a team already owns veo-22.
Upgrade path
A club can start on Veo Go at 279 euros per year, move to a Cam 3 with Starter or Team, and add Analytics 2, Live or Player Spotlight without changing platform veo-02, veo-22. Plans scale to Club at 10 teams and Enterprise at 20 teams, with catalogue discounts for upgrading from an Editor-only plan veo-02. There is no path to fixed multi-camera production or white-label OTT inside Veo veo-04.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the follow-cam framing on a wide pitch against the interactive panorama, because reviewers say the automatic view stays wide veo-19. Test Analytics 2 jersey-number linking on a youth team with rotating shirts, since the whole individual data layer depends on it veo-17. Test the download workflow end to end, because only the follow-cam MP4 leaves the platform veo-23.

Company

Ownership and funding Veo Technologies ApS, CVR 37240834, is a private Danish company that raised 22.5 million dollars in Series B in January 2022 and 80 million dollars in Series C in June 2022 led by pension fund ATP with Seed Capital, Ventech and Chr. Augustinus Fabrikker, for a total above 113 million dollars veo-08, veo-09. Chr. Augustinus Fabrikker has held more than 10 percent since December 2020, Lars Thinggaard chairs the board and Henrik Teisbæk is CEO veo-10.

Financials Danish filings show revenue of 446.1 million kroner in 2024 and 503.9 million kroner in 2025, an operating loss of 16.4 million kroner in 2025 against 46.7 million in 2024, a net loss of 4.6 million kroner in 2025 against 58.1 million in 2024, and equity of 177.9 million kroner on total assets of 574.1 million veo-08. Losses peaked at 167.7 million kroner in 2023 veo-08.

Scale, company-stated Veo stated 4.5 million matches recorded, more than 100 million auto-generated highlights, 2.5 million registered users, more than 13 million goals captured and presence in more than 100 countries in September 2025 veo-11. Chr. Augustinus Fabrikker lists 320 employees, and in June 2022 Veo reported 15,000 club customers in 80 countries and one million recorded matches veo-10, veo-09.
